title: Santol Real Sandalwood Daily Face Wash

details.description: Real Sandalwood Daily Face Wash is a gentle cleansing face wash enriched with the soothing goodness of real sandalwood. It effectively removes dirt, excess oil, and everyday impurities while leaving the skin feeling fresh, clean, and revitalised. Its refreshing formula helps maintain a clear and comfortable complexion without feeling harsh or drying, making it suitable for daily use. The calming sandalwood fragrance adds a pleasant touch to your skincare routine, leaving your skin feeling soft, refreshed, and naturally revitalised.

Pure Sandalwood Perfume Spray captures the rich, warm, and timeless fragrance of pure sandalwood in a refreshing and long-lasting spray. Its elegant woody aroma provides a soothing and sophisticated scent that is suitable for everyday wear as well as special occasions. The lightweight formula is easy to apply and leaves a pleasant lingering fragrance, helping you feel fresh, confident, and delicately scented throughout the day.
details.usageInstructions:
Shake well before use. Hold the container upright and spray from a distance of approximately 15 cm from the body. Do not spray near the eyes or on broken skin, cuts, or burns.
Caution: Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from direct sunlight. Do not expose to temperatures exceeding 50°C. Do not pierce or burn the container, even after use. Keep out of reach of children.
